propositions: Under `-n 3 --dist worksteal`, each xdist worker independently renders all 178 corpus bodies via process-local lru_cache, causing three redundant whole-corpus fills (44-47s each) where serial pays one fill, wasting 56s+ of CPU on identical immutable output
The three `test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical` parametrizations each recompute pass-1 renders that `_rendered()` already cached, duplicating 10-13s per test
A process-local cache cannot be shared between xdist workers, forcing duplication of expensive pandoc spawns across workers in a session
Session-scoped disk artifact keyed by corpus content digest, renderer source digest, and pandoc version must replace process-local lru_cache to enable cross-worker sharing

Per-stratum artifact sharding with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order and atomic lock (os.mkdir/os.replace) allows concurrent fill of different strata, reducing cold-session wall time from whole-corpus to one stratum
Loser fallback deadline of 150s below --timeout=300 guard allows workers blocked on crashed winner to render locally and finish within timeout instead of deadlocking
